Every contest of the November 5, 2024 election, by parish and by precinct, as the results site's download offers it; the workbook's own line reads 'Election Date: 2024-11-05'. The Secretary marks this election's results official (ElectionDates.htm). The vote rows stored are this workbook's.

Every contest of the December 7, 2024 election, by parish and by precinct, as the results site's download offers it; the workbook's own line reads 'Election Date: 2024-12-07'. The Secretary marks this election's results official (ElectionDates.htm). The vote rows stored are this workbook's.
gaps: Louisiana declares a lone qualified candidate elected and prints no contest, so such offices are not in the results files and are not stored.
The November results send this contest to a runoff, but no December contest of the same office, place and choices was found, so no runoff is stored.
